caseName: Ocean City v. Federal Reserve Bank
caseNameFull: Ocean City v. Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia.
attorneys: Messrs. George A. Bourgeois, Harry A. Coulomb, and William B. Hunter for petitioner. Messrs. Yale L. Schekter and Clarence L. Cole for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit denied, without prejudice to the right to apply for a reinstatement of the petition at any time before the end of this term in case a new trial shall not be awarded.
